composition_label: Product comparison (Smart product search) -> Feedback analysis (Customer insights)

shared_schema.envelope: schema_version, data_label, products, preferences, feedback; comparison adds status and comparison; feedback adds insights
shared_schema.products: Unique id, nonempty name, attributes object
shared_schema.attributes: Canonical price (USD), weight (kg), battery_hours (hours); aliases cost, mass, battery. Numeric values use canonical units; strings support USD/$, kg/g, h/hours/min. Nonnegative finite values only.
shared_schema.preferences: Canonical attribute -> {weight: finite nonnegative number, direction: min|max}; at least one positive weight; every product must supply all preference attributes
shared_schema.feedback: Unique id, known product_id, nonempty text containing at least one word
shared_schema.comparison: Ordered rows with product_id, consecutive rank, score in [0,1], normalized attributes for side-by-side comparison
shared_schema.insights: Rank-ordered product rows with propagated score/rank, raw_count, unique_count, themes and exact supporting excerpts with source IDs
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate function checks all stage boundaries, strict object fields, referential integrity, measurements, ranking and excerpt provenance

cross_stage_handoffs: compare validates input, normalizes attributes, produces and validates comparison envelope
feedback_analysis accepts only validated comparison envelope, preserves ranked product metadata and source feedback, then validates final insights

behavior.ranking: Weighted min-max utilities across products; equal-valued criteria contribute 1; weights scaled to prevent overflow; scores rounded to 12 decimals; ties sorted by product ID
behavior.deduplication: Within each product only, casefolded Unicode word sequences ignoring punctuation and whitespace. Duplicate source IDs and every exact original excerpt are retained.
behavior.themes: Deterministic whole-word keyword themes battery, portability, quality, value; general fallback. Counts use unique feedback groups; a group may support multiple themes.
behavior.no_feedback: Products remain present with zero counts and empty themes
behavior.error_contract: Invalid input, JSON, arguments, encoding or file errors print one JSON object with status error and exit 2; success prints one JSON object and exits 0
behavior.fixture: example_input.json is explicitly labeled synthetic; products and feedback are fictional
behavior.side_effects: Pipeline deep-copies input; CLI reads one input file and writes stdout only

test_outcomes.cli_output: One JSON object, status ok; three ranked products with traceable feedback insights
